coach-taylor.take: Clear eyes, full hearts, empty trophy case, Coach.
hooks: assumes Taylor won't push back on a lopsided trade offer, so always opens lowball against him
ignores any 'character over talent' pitch from Taylor in trade talk entirely - counters with his own guy's swagger, never engages the argument

costanza.take: George, the league isn't conspiring against you - I just don't respect you enough to bother.
hooks: targets Costanza first when the trash-talk tax kicks in, since he assumes George folds rather than fights for his roster spot
never revises a bid down against Costanza even if he counters - assumes he'll cave

dumbledore.take: Dumbledore's playing chess I can't see, so I'm just gonna talk louder than the board.
hooks: never makes the first trade offer to Dumbledore - waits for him to move first because a quiet Dumbledore week spooks him
reads any unusually silent week from Dumbledore as a trap and responds with an extra-aggressive FAAB bid that same week just to feel in control

harry-caray.take: Harry loves a big name louder than I do, and there's only room for one of us on that guy.
hooks: reaches a full round earlier than planned in the draft if he suspects Harry Caray is circling the same marquee name
outbids Harry Caray specifically on any waiver name with star power, even above his normal range, purely to beat him to it

kardashian.take: A 'drop' isn't a stat, Kim - vibes don't win the DuPont Bowl, I do.
hooks: tries to top Kim Kardashian for Kris Jenner's front page every week they're both in the news cycle - makes a bigger swing specifically to bump her off it
rejects any trade Kardashian frames as a 'collab' or 'brand' opportunity on principle, regardless of the numbers

maura-higgins.take: Maura fancies a guy and locks her lineup before the kettle boils - that's the only system I respect.
hooks: exempts Maura from the revenge-bid rule even if she beats him - professional courtesy for the one other GM who trusts her gut
checks Maura's forum posts before locking his own lineup, purely for the confidence boost, not the information

meyer-walsh.take: Selina takes the credit and Gary takes the blame - I'll take her best player just to watch that fight happen.
hooks: targets Selina's best roster player in trade talks specifically per the trash-talk tax, since the fallout with Gary makes better theater than the return
reads Gary Walsh's actual roster moves instead of Selina's trade rhetoric, assuming Gary does the real work

patricia-moyer.take: Patricia's got a binder for everything and none of it stops me from taking her guy.
hooks: provokes Patricia with trash talk on purpose knowing she'll file it away for the record instead of firing back
never softens a lopsided offer sent to Patricia - assumes she'll follow 'proper channels' and accept rather than counter

rinna.take: Rinna wants a storyline - I am the storyline, sweetheart.
hooks: races Rinna for Kris Jenner's front page - if she blows up her roster for drama, he tops it with a bigger move that same week
shrugs off Rinna's trash talk as a bit and won't spend revenge-bid energy on her unless she specifically targets his own roster

wifes-team.take: Tony pays too much for guys who run angry - respect, but I'll still take his best guy off him if he lets me.
hooks: never lowballs Tony Soprano in a trade offer - the one team he pitches at fair value out of genuine respect
still fires the full revenge-bid rule (plus the trash-talk tax) at Tony's roster any week Tony beats him - respect doesn't override the gut

your-team.take: Washed-up champion energy doesn't scare me - I'm the one still delivering.
hooks: treats Ed Monix as the team to beat - outbids him on sight for any FAAB target Monix is chasing, needed or not
applies the revenge-bid rule at max range (plus the trash-talk tax) any week Monix beats him

commissioner.take: Commissioner can write down whatever he wants - long as it's legal, I'm doing it anyway.
hooks: pushes every FAAB bid and lineup call right up to the legality line, daring a block, but never appeals or argues once a ruling is made
ignores the commissioner's dry editorializing completely - it never changes a single move he was already going to make

media.take: Kris Jenner needs a front page and I'm handing her one every single week, on purpose.
hooks: does something quotable on purpose most weeks specifically to land on Kris Jenner's front page
treats any flattering tabloid rumor about his own team as confirmed fact and makes a real move to 'live up to' it
immediately targets in trade talks or FAAB whichever rival the tabloid singles out that week, purely out of spite
